abstractEnglish: For every fixed finite set of distinct positive primes, we prove that at least $`cx/(\log x)^2`$ primes in $`(x,2x)`$ have every member of the set as a primitive root, for some c > 0 and all sufficiently large x. The result assumes four explicitly stated analytic and sieve inputs from the companion paper on primitive roots for admissible integer bases.
